notes.title: Ocean Planet 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Ocean Planet - Golden Scuba Tank DLC has been released![/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421290/Ocean_Planet__Golden_Scuba_Tank/]View & purchase here.[/url]
[*] Improved main map load times drastically.
[*] Improved gameplay and level design in certain sections to be more speedrun-friendly.
[*] Fixed visual issues in certain sections.
[*] Fixed leaderboards duplicating users.
[*] Leaderboards should scroll smoother now.
[*] And more!
[/list]

Congratulations to Cuttyflame for achieving the first sub 5!

notes.title: Ocean Planet 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the full settings menu to the pause screen.
[*] In-game settings now save properly.
[*] Controller button rebinds are greyed out unless a controller is connected.
[*] Fixed the camera animation breaking in the settings menu.
[*] Fixed some issues in Challenge 15.
[*] Main Game best times now sync correctly with leaderboards and profiles.
[*] Fixed leaderboard profile banners not updating.
[*] The secret achievement now works and shows up in the achievements section.
[*] And more!
[/list]
